answers.winedna_summary: {"style":"You reach for medium-bodied, dry reds with balanced tannins and acidity — wines built on harmony rather than power or intensity.","love":"Your top scores cluster around softer-tannin, lighter reds from Rioja and the Rhône — seek out Tempranillo and Grenache for your next outstanding bottle."}
answers.sommelier_long: "I tend to gravitate toward Rioja Reservas — particularly the classic Haro producers like Ardanza, Tondonia, and Imperial — though I also enjoy the southern Rhône occasionally. I'm usually happy spending somewhere in the £20–£45 GBP range for a bottle with some age and structure."
